frozen_candidate_root_contribution: TmE encodes an active, forward-leaning eager desire directed at an unattained future good — an expectant reaching-toward whose object is desired but not yet possessed and typically not within the subject's own power. It is the appetitive/positive pole set explicitly against the aversive pole of خَوْف (reaching vs. recoil). The lexeme is valence-neutral: whether an instance reads as legitimate hope, naive expectation, or culpable covetousness/presumption is supplied entirely by context (the object's licitness and whether the aspirant has warrant), never by the root itself.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 12 occurrences طمع names an eager reaching toward something wanted but not yet had. In the fixed pair خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا (lightning shown, or God invoked, in fear-and-طمع) it is the hopeful counterpart of fear. As a verb it almost always governs أَنْ + a not-yet-realized favorable outcome (being forgiven, admitted to the Garden, increased, others believing). The very same construction is praised for the deserving (Ibrahim, believers at 5:84) and rebuked for the presumptuous (70:38, 74:15) or the predatory (33:32) — so the moral color is contextual, not built into the word.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Does NOT entail: (1) attainment or possession — the object is always still unheld, made explicit at 7:46 لَمْ يَدْخُلُوهَا وَهُمْ يَطْمَعُونَ; (2) certainty or a warranted/likely outcome — can be portrayed as naive (2:75) or presumptuous (70:38); (3) any fixed moral valence — the same root is licit (5:84) and illicit (33:32); (4) fear/aversion — it is the lexical antithesis of خوف, never its synonym; (5) mere neutral epistemic forecast — 33:32 shows raw appetite, not prediction; (6) completed action — no perfect form occurs, all verbal tokens are imperfect, matching an ongoing not-yet-completed reaching. NOT inherently 'greed' and NOT inherently 'pious hope' — both are emergent contextual readings.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 33:32 فَيَطْمَعَ ٱلَّذِى فِى قَلْبِهِۦ مَرَضٌ — the only verbal token that is simultaneously illicit/predatory, absolute (no أَنْ-complement), and directed at a person rather than a divine/eschatological outcome. It most pressures any pure 'hope' gloss. It nonetheless bridges to the one nucleus: soft speech (a perceptual cue of attainability) kindles eager reaching toward a not-possessed object, exactly parallel to lightning kindling طمع for rain in 13:12/30:24; its أَنْ-less syntax is shared with the licit 7:46, so the absolute construction spans both valences and marks no separate sense. Its negativity is supplied by the illicit object and diseased subject, not by a distinct lexeme.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A two-sense lexical split: (A) legitimate God-directed hope/expectation vs. (B) illicit/presumptuous covet-greed, since 74:15 and 33:32 resist a bleached 'hope' gloss while خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا resists a 'greed' gloss. This is defeated Quran-internally by the minimal pair 5:84 نَطْمَعُ أَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ (approved) vs. 70:38 أَيَطْمَعُ … أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ (rebuked): same verb, same أَنْ + 'be admitted to the Garden' object, opposite valence differing only in the aspirant's desert. A lexical split cannot explain a valence flip under identical construction; a single valence-neutral nucleus with pragmatically-supplied polarity can.

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge on one valence-neutral nucleus (eager reaching toward an unpossessed anticipated good) demonstrable across all 12 tokens, both the nominal and verbal classes, Meccan and Medinan material, 8 surahs. The competing two-sense split is actively refuted by the 5:84↔70:38 minimal pair, and the strongest counterexample (33:32) bridges rather than breaks — so RESISTANT/UNRESOLVED is not warranted. Strength is capped below STRONG for two contract-flagged reasons: (a) the nominal class (4/12, one third) is a frozen lexicalized doublet خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا that collapses to ~2 independent discourse contexts (lightning-sign 13:12≈30:24; invocation 32:16≈7:56), weakening the breadth behind the خوف-anchor — precisely the lexicalized/nominal sub-class the contract says caps at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE; (b) holding pious (26:82) and predatory (33:32) tokens together requires a valence-neutral abstraction plus a two-component desire+expectation synthesis rather than one clean primitive, and a skeptic can still read 33:32/70:38/74:15 as a covetous-presumptuous cluster. Inter-root distinctiveness from other hope/desire roots (رجاء/أمل/رغب) is not decidable here as none co-occur; only the خوف antonym-contrast is internally available. Hence MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE, PREFERRED.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Nominal accusative طَمَعًا, invariably in the fixed antithetical doublet خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا: طمع as the positive-anticipation pole (eager reaching toward a hoped good — rain heralded by lightning, or God's mercy/reward) set against fear's negative-recoil pole. Semantically transparent and continuous with the verbal nucleus.
clusters.classification_rationale: All four tokens share one accusative surface form and one collocation, functioning near-adverbially ('in awe and eager expectancy'). None carries a greedy/illicit edge; they occupy the cleanest hopeful-anticipation pole and fix طمع as the lexical antonym of خوف. This is a lexicalized formulaic doublet, hence strength-capping, but bridged to the same nucleus.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 13:12 and 30:24 yoke طمع to appetite for the beneficial rain; 32:16 and 7:56 yoke it to hope of mercy/reward in invocation. The invariant خوف↔طمع pairing is the single most informative internal signature that طمع is appetitive reaching, not aversion.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form-I imperfect verb 'to طمع' = to eagerly reach/aspire toward a favorable outcome not yet realized. Six of eight govern أَنْ + a future beneficial event (forgiveness 26:51/26:82; admission 5:84/70:38; increase 74:15; others' belief 2:75); two are absolute with the object contextually recovered (7:46 the not-yet-entered Garden; 33:32 the illicit object). Valence is contextual: praised (26:82, 5:84), naive (2:75), presumptuous (70:38, 74:15), predatory (33:32), wistful (7:46).
clusters.classification_rationale: Uniformly imperfect (ongoing, not-yet-completed), object uniformly future/unattained and typically not in the subject's power. The praised↔rebuked flip under identical construction (5:84 vs. 70:38) proves polarity is pragmatic, not lexical, forcing a single valence-neutral verbal sense.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 26:82 أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى (laudable) and 33:32 فَيَطْمَعَ ٱلَّذِى فِى قَلْبِهِۦ مَرَضٌ (condemned) co-membership proves valence-neutrality; 7:46 لَمْ يَدْخُلُوهَا وَهُمْ يَطْمَعُونَ proves non-attainment; 70:38/74:15/2:75 rebukes attack the presumption of reach, presupposing an underlying wanting.

reconciliation.rationale: Its cue→طمع trigger mirrors the lightning→طمع of 13:12/30:24 and its absolute syntax is shared with the licit 7:46; the shared core (eager reaching toward an unpossessed desired object) holds, with valence supplied by the illicit object and diseased subject. It confirms the contextual-valence finding rather than refuting it.

adversarial_verification.notes: The falsifying hypothesis — two lexicalized senses (legitimate hope vs. illicit covet) — is refuted by the 5:84↔70:38 minimal pair (identical verb + أَنْ + Garden-admission object, opposite valence), and the strongest counterexample 33:32 bridges via the cue→reaching parallel with 13:12/30:24 and shared absolute syntax with 7:46. No occurrence fails the single valence-neutral nucleus; distinctiveness holds against the only co-present neighbour (خوف, as antonym). Inter-root distinctiveness from other hope/desire roots is not internally testable (none co-occur) and is recorded as a bounded limitation, not a failing occurrence.

independent_verification: All three independent lenses (A, B, C) ran the two-sense disproof and independently found it collapses on the 5:84↔70:38 minimal pair, and all three independently judged 33:32 to bridge rather than resist.
candidate_root_contribution: TmE encodes an active, forward-leaning eager desire directed at an unattained future good — an expectant reaching-toward whose object is desired but not yet possessed and typically not within the subject's own power. It is the appetitive/positive pole set explicitly against the aversive pole of خَوْف (reaching vs. recoil). The lexeme is valence-neutral: whether an instance reads as legitimate hope, naive expectation, or culpable covetousness/presumption is supplied entirely by context (the object's licitness and whether the aspirant has warrant), never by the root itself.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 12/12 tokens read from real Tanzil verse_text: 4 nominal طَمَعًا all in خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا (13:12, 30:24, 32:16, 7:56); 8 verbal imperfect tokens, 6 with أَنْ + future good, 2 absolute (7:46, 33:32).
layer_attribution.derivation: Two derivational realizations of one nucleus: accusative verbal-noun طَمَعًا (near-adverbial, antonym of خوف) and Form-I imperfect verb; uniform imperfect aspect corroborates ongoing, not-yet-completed reaching. qac_verb_form null throughout.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: The nominal طَمَعًا is a lexicalized formulaic doublet (خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا, 4/12, ~2 independent contexts) — semantically transparent and continuous with the verbal nucleus but strength-capping as a frozen collocation.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Moral polarity (pious hope / naive expectation / presumption / predatory lust) is contributed by context — the object's licitness and the aspirant's desert — and is a contextual/narrative layer, NOT part of the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: 33:32 preliminarily flagged RESISTANT (absolute, illicit, person-directed) reconciled to CONSISTENT via its cue→reaching parallel with 13:12/30:24 and shared absolute syntax with 7:46; the two-sense split reconciled away by the 5:84↔70:38 minimal pair.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: No final root-level resistance. Bounded UNRESOLVED item: inter-root distinctiveness of طمع from other hope/desire roots (رجاء/أمل/رغب) is not decidable within this packet as none co-occur; only the خوف antonym-contrast is internally available.

hard_cases.reason: The single token most pressuring the nucleus: illicit/predatory, absolute (no أَنْ), and person-directed rather than aimed at a divine/eschatological good. It is the case that most tempts a separate 'covet/lust' sense.

evidence_basis.statement: 33:32 فَيَطْمَعَ ٱلَّذِى فِى قَلْبِهِۦ مَرَضٌ bridges to the one nucleus: soft speech (a perceptual cue of attainability) kindles eager reaching toward a not-possessed object, exactly parallel to lightning kindling طمع for rain in 13:12/30:24; its أَنْ-less syntax is shared with the licit 7:46, so the absolute construction spans both valences and marks no separate sense; its negativity is supplied by the illicit object and diseased subject, not by a distinct lexeme.

hard_cases.reason: Half of the decisive minimal pair with 5:84: same verb, same أَنْ + 'be admitted to the Garden' object, but rebuked rather than approved — the test case that would have supported a lexical hope/covet split had valence tracked the lexeme.

evidence_basis.statement: 5:84 نَطْمَعُ أَن يُدْخِلَنَا رَبُّنَا مَعَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ (approved) vs. 70:38 أَيَطْمَعُ … أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ (rebuked): same verb, same object-type, opposite valence differing only in the aspirant's desert, disproving a lexicalized hope/covet split and establishing contextual valence over one nucleus.

hard_case_representation.rationale: No occurrence is finally resistant; the two hard cases are adversarial boundaries whose evidence_basis statements (the 33:32 structural-parallel bridge and the 5:84↔70:38 minimal-pair refutation) are the load-bearing internal proofs cited in strongest_counterexample and strongest_competitor. Both resolve into the single valence-neutral nucleus.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal contrast in which طمع and خوف are used as synonyms or co-polar terms (both aversive or both appetitive), OR a verbal token whose أَنْ/absolute object is already possessed/realized at the moment of طمع, which would break the 'reaching toward an unattained good, opposite to fear' nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: The four خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا tokens (13:12, 30:24, 32:16, 7:56) for the polarity test, and the eight verbal tokens (esp. 7:46, 5:84, 70:38, 74:15) for the attainment/tense test.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each verse_text and QAC morphology to confirm (a) خوف and طمع stand on opposite poles, and (b) the object of every verbal طمع is future/unrealized and imperfect-marked (no perfect form encoding completion).
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Distinguish the frozen nominal doublet (4 tokens, ~2 independent contexts) from the verbal evidence so the collocation is not double-counted as independent breadth; separate contextual moral valence (object licitness, aspirant's desert) from any claimed lexical valence.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If طمع were shown co-polar with خوف, or its object shown already attained, the valence-neutral 'appetitive reaching toward an unattained good' nucleus would collapse and the root would revert to an unresolved or split account.

reopen_conditions: If a future analysis finds any occurrence where طمع's desired object is already possessed/realized (contradicting the not-yet-attained boundary anchored at 7:46 لَمْ يَدْخُلُوهَا وَهُمْ يَطْمَعُونَ), reopen the attainment boundary.

If طمع is found paired with or substituted for خوف as a co-polar (both aversive) term rather than its antithesis, reopen the reaching-vs-recoil polarity claim built on the four خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا tokens.

If a hope/desire neighbour root (رجاء/أمل/رغب) is brought into contrast with طمع and shows a systematic licit/illicit or attainment distinction, reopen the currently-undecided inter-root distinctiveness and re-test whether طمع's valence-neutrality is truly lexical.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The falsifying hypothesis — two lexicalized senses (legitimate hope vs. illicit covet) — is refuted by the 5:84↔70:38 minimal pair (identical verb + أَنْ + Garden-admission object, opposite valence), and the strongest counterexample 33:32 bridges via the cue→reaching parallel with 13:12/30:24 and shared absolute syntax with 7:46. No occurrence fails the single valence-neutral nucleus; distinctiveness holds against the only co-present neighbour (خوف, as antonym). Inter-root distinctiveness from other hope/desire roots is not internally testable (none co-occur) and is recorded as a bounded limitation, not a failing occurrence.
